free_tier.stated: no free tier; Aydin VPS x16 is USD 10.99 a month on the monthly cycle and USD 8.79 a month on the annual cycle for 6 cores, 16 GB of RAM and 120 GB of SSD, with unlimited bandwidth on a 1 Gbps port and no setup fee printed

retention.stated: the disk persists while the plan is paid; the page states no deletion clock

egress.terms: unlimited bandwidth on a 1 Gbps port under a fair-use policy, stated on the configurator; no byte quota and no overage price is printed

record.interface_detail: full administrator access over RDP on a dedicated IPv4; the WHMCS control panel starts, stops, reinstalls and opens a console, and the operating-system select lists Windows Server 2012R2, 2019 and 2022 among the images
record.tooling: any RDP client; the Rabisu panel for reinstall and console
record.chaining: the cheapest 16 GB machine whose operating-system list offers Windows at no printed surcharge, so it is the row a reader reaches for first. What it cannot carry is the licence claim: the machine is cheap and documented, the licence is unresolved, and the two are different facts.
record.limits_note: the page calls the traffic unlimited and adds a fair-use clause; it prints no byte number, no monthly cap and no throttle rate. The port is shared, so the 1 Gbps figure is a ceiling and not a guarantee. The monthly cycle is the default: the monthly radio carries checked in the served HTML, and the four cycles print monthly 10.99, quarterly 9.89, semi-annual 9.34 and annual 8.79, each against the 10.99 reference.
record.binding_note: the shared 1 Gbps port and the unstated fair-use threshold decide sustained throughput; the RAM and disk shapes are not the constraint at this price.

identity_cost.detail: an account and a payment method at order; the configurator's order summary prints no total and the add-to-cart POST was not completed

record.reliability_note: no reliability event observed; the configurator renders a 'please correct the following errors' banner because the add-to-cart POST was not completed, and the 'FREE Setup Fee' text on the page belongs to a cross-sell block rather than to this plan.
record.confidence_note: the machine is documented: the shape, all four cycle rates, the monthly default, the Windows Server images in the operating-system select and the absence of a setup fee are read from the live configurator on 2026-10-26. The licence inclusion is reported and not documented, which is what drags the record down a rung: the sentence 'all Windows VPS plans include a genuine Windows Server license' was carried by an earlier reader from https://www.rabisu.com/vps-windows, that path now returns 404, and the configurator, the home page and the knowledgebase contain zero occurrences of licen, license or genuine. A cart with a licence line, or a vendor statement on a live path, moves this record back to documented.

evidence.proved: quoted: '6 Core CPU ... 16 GB Ram ... 120 GB SSD ... 1 Gbps Port ... Unlimited Bandwith ... Windows / Linux' and 'Monthly $10.99/mo ... Quarterly $9.89/mo Save 10% ... Semi-Annually $9.34/mo Save 15% ... Annually $8.79/mo Save 20%'

quoted from the Operating System select: 'Windows Server 2012R2', 'Windows Server 2019', 'Windows Server 2022' as plain options with no price suffix, while every region upgrade prints its surcharge in the option text, so the OS carries no printed surcharge

the monthly cycle is the default: '<input class="icheck-control" type="radio" value="monthly" name="billingcycle" checked>'; no setup fee is printed for this plan and the order summary prints no total
the path returns HTTP 404 on 2026-10-26, so the sentence is carried as a third-party reading with no live source and the licence is unresolved
the home page (200, 133,582 bytes) returns zero matches for licen, Licen, genuine and license

record.notes: Two claims were separated here on 2026-10-26. The machine is documented and unchanged: USD 10.99 monthly, USD 8.79 annual, 6 cores, 16 GB, 120 GB SSD, monthly cycle as the default, Windows 2012R2, 2019 and 2022 in the OS list at no printed surcharge, no setup fee. The record's url moved from the dead /vps-windows path to the live configurator, which is the page every number above comes from. The annual cycle needs USD 105.48 up front. Region upgrades move the price: on the monthly cycle London, Dublin, Falkenstein, New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas and Beauharnois add USD 5.22, Sydney, Singapore and Hong Kong add USD 8.72, and Karachi adds USD 22.12; the annual cycle scales those to USD 4.18, USD 6.98 and USD 17.70.

extras.windows_licence: unresolved: the vendor FAQ sentence did not reproduce; the OS option carries no price delta, which proves the surcharge is zero and not that a licence is supplied

free_tier.stated: Aydin VPS x4 at USD 2.99 a month on the cart's monthly term, USD 2.69 on the quarterly term, USD 2.54 on the semi-annual term and USD 2.39 on the annual term (the vendor page shows the same 20 percent off annual): 2 Ryzen cores, 4 GB RAM, 40 GB NVMe, dedicated IPv4, free backup with 2 backup points, quoted. The vendor advertises 'unlimited traffic' and 'Fair Usage Traffic'; the tracker row states 10240 GB/month on a 1 Gbps port in Istanbul or Sofia; the cart's region selector prices Istanbul with no surcharge and twelve regions extra (Karachi +USD 11.98; London, Falkenstein, Dublin, New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas and Beauharnois +USD 3.20; Sydney, Singapore and Hong Kong +USD 4.64) and lists no Sofia. Aydin VPS x8 is USD 5.99/month with 4 cores, 8 GB and 60 GB. The cart shows no out-of-stock badge. Renewal: not published on any page.

egress.terms: the vendor says 'unlimited traffic' and marks each plan 'Fair Usage Traffic' with no published number; the tracker states 10240 GB/month. No overage price was published on either page

record.chaining: USD 2.99 a month, USD 2.39 on the annual term, for 2 Ryzen cores, 4 GB and 40 GB of NVMe is the best RAM per dollar here and the cheapest box here that can hold a Docker Compose stack with a database.
